items.title: Cardinals Sign LT Jedrick Wills Jr. After Paris Johnson Jr. Season-Ender
items.one_line: Johnson Jr. done for the year (torn biceps); rookie Jayden Williams starts short-term, Wills (57 starts) signed off BUF practice squad before DET.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love Opens Up on Early NFL Fatigue
items.one_line: No. 3 pick (14-63 on 30 snaps) calls it 'the longest year of my life'; says no major injury, staff rotating him with Allgeier.

items.title: Giants Top Cardinals 36-24
items.one_line: ARI 1-3 after MetLife loss; Banks 98-yd final-play pick-six sealed it.

items.title: Falcons Crush Saints 45-24 with Five Rushing TDs
items.one_line: MNF: Bijan 145 yds/2 TD, B. Robinson Jr. 3 short TDs, Penix 15/20-223; ATL to 2-2.

items.title: Penix Sparks Falcons' Offensive Surge
items.one_line: 40 ppg in two starts since returning from injury (479 yds, 2 TD, 1 INT); Ravens next.

items.title: Falcons Lead NFL in QB Pressures Without Pearce and Walker
items.one_line: 87 pressures (PFF) even with edge rushers James Pearce Jr. and Jalon Walker out.

items.title: Lamar Jackson Ankle Sprain, Durham Smythe Torn Achilles
items.one_line: Lamar non-surgical sprain, only an outside chance to play Sunday at ATL and could miss multiple games; Huntley would start. Smythe out for the season.

items.title: Zay Flowers Sets Ravens Record with 11th 100-Yard Game
items.one_line: 8-118-1 vs TEN despite an earlier hamstring tweak.

items.title: Fans Debate Jesse Minter's Early Head Coaching Run
items.one_line: 3-1 start but D allowing 24 ppg; Minter says Lamar's ankle looks short-term.

items.title: Josh Allen's Late Pick Draws Heat After Loss to Patriots
items.one_line: First loss (29-26); Allen INT into double coverage on final drive, owns it; national debate on Buffalo's reliance on him.

items.title: Gardner-Johnson vs. Vrabel After Chism Game-Winner
items.one_line: CJGJ called Chism a practice-squad guy; Vrabel clapped back at his eight-team journey.

items.title: Allen and Purdy Tied Atop MVP Odds
items.one_line: 19% each on Kalshi; books have Allen +270, Purdy +330.

items.title: Panthers Stun Lions 32-26
items.one_line: Young 329 yds/2 TD, McMillan 14-192-2, Hubbard 122 rush/2 TD; CAR 2-2 and atop NFC South.

items.title: Bryce Young Producing Under Heavy Pressure
items.one_line: League passing-yards leader with a bottom-tier clean-pocket rate; fans eye returns of injured tackles Ekwonu and Moton.

items.title: Young Edges Stroud in Reignited 2023 QB Debate
items.one_line: Warner poll 63% Young in a redraft; Orlovsky calls him top five.

items.title: Ben Johnson Fires Up Packers Rivalry with Locker Room Tirade
items.one_line: Bears 3-1 road favorites at Lambeau with Bagent starting for Caleb Williams (hamstring).

items.title: Bears Re-Sign WR Scotty Miller to Practice Squad
items.one_line: Barrington native back on the PS Tuesday ahead of Green Bay.

items.title: Soldier Field Flyover Fuels Stadium Relocation Talk
items.one_line: Fans push back as the team focuses solely on Indiana (Hammond) for a new stadium.

items.title: Bengals' Under-Center Shift Backfires, Calls for Zac Taylor's Exit
items.one_line: Last in YPP from under center (3.3); 23 rush yds on 15 carries vs JAX; Stephen A. says new coach needed.

items.title: Trevor Lawrence Beats Burrow for First Time, 22-17
items.one_line: Burrow 428 yds but 2 INTs (one pick-six); CIN 2-2 heading to Miami.

items.title: Browns Open IR Return Windows for QB Gabriel and DT Davis
items.one_line: CLE (3-1) designated QB Dillon Gabriel and DT Kalia Davis to return from IR (21-day windows) and signed WR James Proche II and DT Chris Williams to the practice squad, releasing three others, ahead of Week 5.

items.title: Cowboys Host Winless Bucs on Thursday Night Football
items.one_line: DAL (2-2) hosts TB (0-4) Thursday 8:15 p.m. ET on Prime Video with rookie Jalon Daniels starting for injured Baker Mayfield; Dallas favored by 9.5.

items.title: Cowboys Rally Past Texans 34-30
items.one_line: Dallas came back from 10 down at half to win 34-30; CeeDee Lamb had 17 catches for 189 yards and the late game-winning TD, Javonte Williams ran for three second-half scores.

items.title: Joey Porter Jr. Debuts for Cowboys After Steelers Trade
items.one_line: CB Joey Porter Jr., traded from Pittsburgh for future picks, played 24 snaps vs Houston and allowed no catches on one target while easing back from injury.

items.title: Broncos Get Good News on Surtain and Bryant Ankles
items.one_line: MRIs showed no season-ending damage: CB Patrick Surtain II is week-to-week (about two weeks) and WR Pat Bryant has a sprained ankle on a similar timeline, possibly IR until Week 9; Riley Moss also sat with ribs.

items.title: Bo Nix's Conservative Start Raises Questions
items.one_line: Nix is 81-of-135 for 819 yards, 5 TD, 3 INT (80.4 rating) with a 6.7-yard average target depth as DEN (2-2, 18.5 ppg) heads into the Chargers game.

items.title: Greenlaw Fined for Taunting Broncos Bench, Payton
items.one_line: The NFL fined 49ers LB Dre Greenlaw $11,941 for taunting the Broncos bench and ex-coach Sean Payton in SF's 24-14 win; Payton brushed it off.

items.title: Dan Campbell Demands More After 2-2 Start
items.one_line: After the 32-26 loss to Carolina, Campbell called out the whole team on 97.1 The Ticket, set a 35-point offensive bar, and backed his DC ahead of Arizona.

items.title: Lions Pressure QBs but Leak Passing Yards
items.one_line: DET ranks near the top in pressure rate but allows a league-worst 109.3 net passing yards per game under pressure and is last in points (31.8) and yards (423.8) allowed; Brian Branch's return offers hope.

items.title: Packers Edge Bucs 17-14 but Lose Edgerrin Cooper to Torn Achilles
items.one_line: GB (2-2) won 17-14 at Tampa behind two Jordan Love TD passes, but LB Edgerrin Cooper (sack, INT) suffered a season-ending non-contact Achilles tear confirmed by MRI.

items.title: LaFleur: Micah Parsons Won't Practice This Week
items.one_line: Parsons, recovering from a torn ACL/meniscus, won't practice this week and his 21-day window isn't open, making a November debut more likely; GB plays Chicago Oct. 11.

items.title: Ben Johnson Fires Up Bears-Packers Rivalry
items.one_line: Ahead of the Lambeau game, Bears coach Ben Johnson's 'F the Packers' locker-room comments spread; CHI (3-1) is a road favorite with Tyson Bagent starting for hamstring-injured Caleb Williams, while LaFleur stayed measured.

items.title: Texans, Chargers, Bucs All 0-4 After Week 4
items.one_line: HOU enters Week 5 at 0-4 but draws notice for C.J. Stroud's zero INTs in 1,141 yards with 5 TD and advanced metrics ranking them among the best historical 0-4 teams, though defensive issues remain.

items.title: Owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon's Sideline Role Draws Debate
items.one_line: Irsay-Gordon, principal owner since 2025, studies games from the sideline with a headset; OC Jim Bob Cooter backs it, Bill Simmons called it 'nuts,' and players say it doesn't faze them.

items.title: Jaguars Add Two CBs Ahead of London vs Eagles
items.one_line: JAX signed CB Alijah Huzzie off Houston's practice squad, promoted CB Jaylon Jones, waived/injured CB Christian Braswell and put S Caleb Ransaw on IR (knee), with CB Montaric Brown out with a hamstring, before Sunday's London game vs PHI.

items.title: Lawrence Gets First Win Over Burrow, 22-17
items.one_line: Trevor Lawrence went 18-of-23 for 227 yards, a TD and no picks as JAX (3-1) won 22-17 at Cincinnati; Burrow threw for 428 yards with two INTs, one returned for a score.

items.title: Travis Hunter Shining as Shutdown Corner
items.one_line: Hunter allowed one catch on six man-coverage targets with an INT and played all 76 defensive snaps in Week 4, posting an 86.9 coverage grade.

items.title: Tyreek Hill Nears Return, Chiefs in Talks
items.one_line: Drew Rosenhaus expects Hill to sign within days with KC leading amid injuries to Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton; Hill is recovering from a knee injury for a November return, with PHI and SF also mentioned.

items.title: Chiefs Edge Raiders 30-27 Behind Walker's 177 Yards
items.one_line: KC moved to 4-0 as Kenneth Walker III ran for 177 yards and two TDs, Mahomes threw for 225 and two scores, and a late interception stopped the Raiders.

items.title: Chiefs Bench LG Suamataia for Caliendo
items.one_line: Andy Reid benched left guard Kingsley Suamataia for the whole Raiders game in a non-injury coaching decision and started Mike Caliendo, whom Mahomes praised.

items.title: Raiders fall 30-27 to Chiefs in first loss
items.one_line: The Raiders dropped to 3-1 with a 30-27 home loss to the 4-0 Chiefs despite Kirk Cousins throwing for a season-high 365 yards and two touchdowns, while Kenneth Walker III ran for 177 yards and two scores for Kansas City.

items.title: Debate over Ashton Jeanty's slow start
items.one_line: Ashton Jeanty has 264 rushing yards on 78 carries (3.4 avg, no rushing TDs) through four games, with fans citing poor blocking and a lingering ankle injury, while he has 19 catches for 165 yards and two scores.

items.title: Chiefs-Raiders draws record 28.4M viewers
items.one_line: The Week 4 Chiefs-Raiders game drew 28.448 million viewers on CBS, the most-watched game of the 2026 season and the top Week 4 game ever on any network.

items.title: Rashawn Slater high-ankle sprain hits battered O-line
items.one_line: LT Rashawn Slater suffered a high-ankle sprain (4-6 week typical recovery, possible IR) in the 30-23 loss to Seattle, adding to injuries to Joe Alt, Trevor Penning and Ladd McConkey with Awosika and Biadasz already out, and Jim Harbaugh plans to start four rookie linemen alongside Cole Strange ahead of Denver.

items.title: Khalil Mack emerges as trade candidate
items.one_line: Adam Schefter flagged Khalil Mack, on a one-year $18M fully guaranteed deal, as a player to watch before the Nov. 10 deadline for the 0-4 Chargers, though insiders say LA is not shopping him yet.

items.title: Chargers sign Daniel Brunskill to practice squad
items.one_line: The Chargers signed veteran OL Daniel Brunskill to the practice squad Tuesday, releasing DL Jordan Jefferson, and opened practice windows for Scott Matlock and Branson Taylor amid O-line injuries.

items.title: Rams sign Eric Kendricks to practice squad
items.one_line: The Rams signed veteran LB Eric Kendricks to the practice squad Tuesday for depth behind Omar Speights and Nate Landman, who is nursing shoulder issues.

items.title: Rams rally past Eagles 24-20
items.one_line: The Rams came back from a 20-10 halftime deficit to beat the Eagles 24-20 on the road behind two late Kyren Williams rushing touchdowns, moving to 2-2.

items.title: Dolphins fall 15-10 at Vikings
items.one_line: Miami dropped to 0-4 with a 15-10 loss to Minnesota, which won on five field goals and kneeled out the clock after T.J. Hockenson slid down at the 1.

items.title: Jacob Rodriguez sets Dolphins rookie tackle record
items.one_line: Rookie LB Jacob Rodriguez broke Zach Thomas's 1996 franchise rookie mark with 18 tackles against the Vikings and has 46 tackles, an interception and a league-high 24 defensive stops through four games.

items.title: Vikings beat Dolphins 15-10 to reach 4-0
items.one_line: Minnesota improved to 4-0 with a 15-10 win over Miami on five field goals and a stout defense, with T.J. Hockenson catching 13 passes and sliding down at the 1 to let the Vikings kneel out the clock.

items.title: O'Connell details run-first approach behind 4-0 start
items.one_line: On The Pat McAfee Show, Kevin O'Connell stressed running the ball and protecting it, with the defense leading the NFL at 12.8 points allowed per game and Justin Jefferson out, as the Vikings head to New Orleans.

items.title: Patriots edge Bills 29-26 on late Maye-Chism TD
items.one_line: Drake Maye threw three touchdowns, including a late 23-yard one-handed catch by Efton Chism III, and Craig Woodson's interception sealed a 29-26 win at Buffalo that moved New England to 2-2.

items.title: Falcons crush Saints 45-24 on MNF
items.one_line: Atlanta ran for 205 yards and five rushing touchdowns to beat New Orleans 45-24, dropping the Saints to 1-3 despite Tyler Shough's 286 passing yards, with Cam Jordan calling it a 'gut punch.'

items.title: Saints fans question Kellen Moore after blowout
items.one_line: Fans called for better game planning and possible staff changes from Kellen Moore's second-year staff, while Moore urged the team to learn from the loss ahead of facing unbeaten Minnesota.

items.title: Kendre Miller fumble sparks cut calls
items.one_line: RB Kendre Miller had two carries for zero yards and a lost fumble against Atlanta, prompting fan demands to cut him, though no roster moves have been announced.

items.title: Giants take NFC East lead with 36-24 win over Cardinals
items.one_line: The Giants beat Arizona 36-24 to move to 3-1 and sole possession of first in the NFC East for the first time since 2015, with Jameis Winston throwing three TD passes and Deonte Banks returning a 98-yard pick-six on the final play.

items.title: Braxton Berrios out for season after foot surgery
items.one_line: WR/returner Braxton Berrios needs surgery for a foot and ankle injury from Sunday's win and will miss the rest of 2026, with Charlie Jones stepping in on returns and Chauncey Golston dealing with a neck issue.

items.title: Jets fans debate Mougey vs. Glenn blame after 1-3 start
items.one_line: After a 23-12 loss to the Bears dropped New York to 1-3 and third in the AFC East, fans are split on whether GM Darren Mougey or coach Aaron Glenn deserves more blame, with the Browns, Patriots, Dolphins and Raiders up next.

items.title: Bears' Ben Johnson encourages Jets' Aaron Glenn after 23-12 win
items.one_line: Ben Johnson told Aaron Glenn 'You guys are close' after Chicago beat the Jets 23-12, running 89 plays to New York's 32 and holding the ball for 43 minutes while Kyle Monangai ran for 146 yards and two scores.

items.title: Rams rally late to beat Eagles 24-20 in Philly
items.one_line: The Eagles blew a 20-10 lead and fell to 2-2 as Jalen Hurts threw for 93 yards on 12-of-27, Philadelphia went 0-for-12 on third downs, and the team lost Saquon Barkley to a hamstring injury plus DeVonta Smith and Dallas Goedert.

items.title: Eagles take late Friday flight to London for Jaguars game
items.one_line: The 2-2 Eagles will practice normally at home and fly to London on Friday for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, a plan Nick Sirianni says suits their schedule, which has no bye before a home game against Carolina.

items.title: Steelers sign Murphy-Bunting, put Derrick Harmon on IR
items.one_line: Pittsburgh signed CB Sean Murphy-Bunting off the Buccaneers' practice squad, put DT Derrick Harmon on IR with a foot injury, added LB Marte Mapu to the practice squad and waived DB Doneiko Slaughter after trading Joey Porter Jr. and losing Jamel Dean to injury, ahead of Sunday against the Colts.

items.title: McCarthy: Steelers must 'clean our own house' after Browns loss
items.one_line: After a 27-24 loss to the Browns left Pittsburgh 2-2, Mike McCarthy said 'our house is not clean right now' and the team spent a full day on film before Colts prep, while Pat Freiermuth said the locker room is united.

items.title: Steelers add CB Terell Smith off Commanders' practice squad
items.one_line: On Tuesday Pittsburgh signed CB Terell Smith off Washington's practice squad, a day after adding Murphy-Bunting, to add depth after the Porter Jr. trade and with Jamel Dean out with an ankle injury.

items.title: Undefeated 49ers visit Seahawks in key NFC West clash
items.one_line: The 3-1 Seahawks host the 4-0 49ers Sunday at 4:25 p.m. ET at Lumen Field, with betting lines favoring Seattle by three points and Kyle Shanahan saying 'We don't like them.'

items.title: Seahawks pass on Joe Mixon after physical, add Robert Henry Jr.
items.one_line: Seattle did not sign Joe Mixon after he failed a physical tied to his 2025 foot injury, instead signing RB Robert Henry Jr. off Washington's practice squad and adding Dontae McMillan to the practice squad, while Jadarian Price recovers from a chest injury and Zach Charbonnet rehabs a torn ACL.

items.title: Undefeated 49ers head to Seattle for NFC West clash
items.one_line: The 4-0 49ers play their first real road game Sunday at 3-1 Seattle at 4:25 p.m. ET, with Brock Purdy at 11 TDs and one INT and injuries to Kyle Juszczyk and Nick Bosa looming, and lines favoring the Seahawks by three.

items.title: 49ers injury update after 24-14 win over Broncos
items.one_line: For the 49ers, Kyle Juszczyk's knee sprain and bone bruise will sideline him 2-3 weeks, safety Marques Sigle has a high ankle sprain for a few weeks, CB Upton Stout is day-to-day with a shoulder sprain, and the story says DE Nick Bosa and DT James Thompson Jr. sit out this week.

items.title: Brock Purdy leads early MVP talk after 4-0 start
items.one_line: Purdy leads the league with a 126.2 passer rating, 1,007 yards, 11 TDs and one INT without being sacked through four games, and betting markets have him tied with Josh Allen at 19% for MVP.

items.title: Buccaneers fall to 0-4, fans demand coaching changes
items.one_line: Tampa Bay is 0-4 for its worst start since 2013 after a 17-14 home loss to Green Bay, with Todd Bowles taking full responsibility, Tristan Wirfs giving a 'no comment' on the coach's future, and a Thursday road game at Dallas next.

items.title: Commanders' Jaylin Lane out for season with fractured ankle
items.one_line: WR/returner Jaylin Lane fractured and dislocated his ankle in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Colts in London, ending his season, while Washington, now 1-3, has backup QB Marcus Mariota's MCL sprain uncertain and Jayden Daniels and Terry McLaurin working back from ailments before the Giants game.

items.title: Commanders expect Jayden Daniels back vs. Giants
items.one_line: Washington plans for QB Jayden Daniels to return from a left elbow injury and start Sunday at home against the Giants after missing two games, with a full practice week planned.
